about: Paper 2's sources. status: read = the claim the text takes from it was checked in the source itself; index = the bibliographic record checked (Crossref), the content not; secondary = checked only as another source cites it. Each says what the text uses it for. refs-crossref.mjs caches each DOI's Crossref record (CSL JSON) in data/crossref.json; build.mjs makes draft/references.json from both.
